Weapon skill effects and transfer
entities.summary: Weapon skills are attributes that can improve combat, amplify elemental effects, or change drops. The source describes moving a skill between weapons at the Smithy as requiring an open slot and a fee.

entities.name: Weapon skill KO unlocks
entities.summary: Some weapon skills unlock after the weapon reaches a required KO count; the skill cannot be transferred until its seal is broken.

entities.name: Adventure Mode map objective
entities.summary: Adventure Mode places battles on a 16-by-8 board modeled on the original Zelda map. The described goal on each map is to find the key to the boss dungeon and defeat its boss.

entities.name: Adventure Mode map unlock sequence
entities.summary: Clearing the first Adventure Map opens the Great Sea Map; clearing Great Sea opens Master Quest, and completing Master Quest opens both Termina and Twilight Maps.
